findings.summary: Runtime-free roplat_native and shared roplat_msgs missing from guidance. Original roplat paths are re-exported, so existing imports must not be blindly rewritten. Message-only crates need the roplat_native alias for generated macro paths.

Old text says layout cache lasts one activation. Main uses a process cache keyed by class and native layout, buffer-protocol copies and deduplicated sys.path insertion; publish 0.5.1 still has activation-local layout checks.

Main recording requires RecordData and schema metadata; constructors/wrappers return Result; explicit finish is required and RLOG v4 does not accept v3/JSON-lines. New streaming, causal and media capabilities were unmentioned.

Main adds MPSC/broadcast/variable IPC; TcpOptions literals need additional fields/default extension, full-queue defaults changed to Error, typed same-host transport tries shared memory, latest publish uses sender-side replacement.
Existing skill examples do not run Recording/Replay, IPC, media or foreign-language bindings; the documentation changes are source-reviewed, not runtime validation of those capabilities.
